items.headline: First day of fall brings fun and football superlatives to SEC Now
items.description: Fozzy Whittaker convinces Gene Chizik to sip his seasonal latte as Peter Burns asks the duo which SEC teams fit different fall staples.

items.headline: Fozzy's SEC Tiers: Which middle-tier teams are ready to break through?
items.description: After dividing the 16 SEC teams into four tiers, Fozzy Whitaker explains his rationale while fellow SEC Now analyst Gene Chizik weighs in.

items.headline: Kentucky's Jordan Castell explains why his family means so much to him
items.description: Castell joins The Paul Finebaum Show after his stellar performance that led to an upset win against Texas A&M to discuss his love for his family and bowling.

items.headline: Will Stein credits Kentucky's preparation for win over Texas A&M
items.description: Stein relives the Wildcats' upset win in College Station and says the build up to that win starts with a great week of practice and all the way back to the offseason.

items.headline: College Football Playoff 2026: Bubble Watch after Week 3
items.description: Putting the spotlight on select teams and questions around others as the early playoff picture takes shape.

items.headline: Block Party: Florida's Jadan Baugh, Tennessee tackles laying the boom
items.description: SEC Network's Cole Cubelic and Roman Harper go around the SEC to find the most vicious blocks of the weekend, headlined by the Volunteers' dominating performance.
